actions.action: Inspect the white dots with a loupe to rule out scale
Optionally dab a little diluted alcohol around the wound once
Alternatively dust the wound with sulfur or cinnamon
Keep water out of the wound and the central rosette when watering
After letting it settle 1–2 weeks, plant in very gritty, fast-draining soil
Acclimate gradually to full outdoor sun over 1–2 weeks if moving outside
Check weekly for a month for spreading brown/black tissue, softness or odor
If rot appears, cut out the affected area with a clean knife and keep dry

reason: The answer correctly calls it a harmless puncture that will callus, and its main advice (leave it alone, keep it dry) matches the fix that worked, with no harmful suggestions.
